top_findings: All 17 canonical URLs resolve to localhost:4321 (Astro site config not set)
No robots.txt and no sitemap.xml — bots have no crawl directives
No structured data on the homepage (no WebApplication or Organization schema)
OG image /og-default.png returns 404 on every page — social sharing broken
8 empty img src attributes across all tool pages
quick_wins: Set site in astro.config.mjs — fixes all canonicals in 2 minutes
Generate and drop in robots.txt + sitemap.xml
Fix em dash encoding: use — instead of raw unicode \u2014

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Clean, semantic URLs with no query parameters
All pages are plain HTML — no JS-rendering dependency
Mobile viewport meta present on every page
PWA manifest and service worker for offline capability

findings.title: Canonical URLs resolve to localhost:4321
findings.description: Astro site config is empty, so Astro.url.href defaults to the dev server address. Affects all 17 pages. Google would index every URL as http://localhost:4321/...
findings.recommendation: Set site: 'https://yourdomain.com' in astro.config.mjs

findings.title: No robots.txt file
findings.description: No robots.txt exists in dist/ or public/. Bots have no crawl directives — critical for launch.
findings.recommendation: Create public/robots.txt with Allow: / and Sitemap: directive

findings.title: No sitemap.xml
findings.description: No sitemap generated. Astro sitemap integration not installed. Google Discovery depends on sitemaps for new sites.
findings.recommendation: Install @astrojs/sitemap and add to astro.config.mjs integrations

findings.title: No robots meta tag on any page
findings.description: Without a robots.txt, there is no page-level index/nofollow control via meta robots either.
findings.recommendation: Add robots meta via Base.astro layout

findings.title: Service worker may cache HTML aggressively
findings.description: Default Workbox precache can cause stale content. Cache strategy should be audited before launch.
findings.recommendation: Review sw.js caching strategy — ensure HTML uses network-first

findings.title: Single monolithic CSS blocks first paint
findings.description: 29 KB single CSS file (_astro/_slug_.BFpP6dMR.css) loads on every page. Most tool pages use only ~40% of these styles.
findings.recommendation: Extract critical CSS per page, or split into per-viewport chunks

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: AI crawlers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI) have no structured content manifest.
findings.recommendation: Create public/llms.txt with tool listing and blog post URLs

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Well-researched, original content on every tool page
Step-by-step tutorials with technical depth
Excellent readability — short paragraphs, clear headings
Unique privacy angle (browser-based processing) as differentiator

findings.title: Thin content on 4 pages
findings.description: Terms (265w), Blog Index (287w), GIF to MP4 (297w), Privacy (358w) risk being classified as low-value by Google. Terms/Privacy need 500-800 words minimum for trust signals.
findings.recommendation: Expand Terms to 600+ words, Privacy to 800+ words. Add intro paragraph to Blog Index. Add comparison table to GIF to MP4 page.

findings.title: optimize-gifs-core-web-vitals.md not in dist
findings.description: This blog post exists in src/content/blog/ but was not built. If intended for launch, it needs inclusion.
findings.recommendation: Include in the build or remove from source.

findings.title: 6 landing pages in src not built
findings.description: Pages targeting high-intent queries (compress-gif-for-discord, -email, -twitter, -to-256kb, -under-1mb, -under-8mb) exist in src but are not in dist.
findings.recommendation: Complete and ship these pages — they target high-search-volume queries.

findings.title: Blog index uses H2s for article cards
findings.description: Article titles are marked up as H2 without wrapping in article or ul/li structure. This flattens the document outline.
findings.recommendation: Wrap each blog card in <article> with H2 as heading.

findings.title: Resize GIF page lacks instructional depth
findings.description: Only 'More tools' as the single H2 after the dropzone. Needs competitive instructional content.
findings.recommendation: Add how-to steps, use cases, and aspect ratio guidance.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique, keyword-rich title tags on every page (60-70 chars)
Unique meta descriptions under 160 chars with strong CTAs
OG and Twitter card tags present on every page
Proper html lang='en' attribute

findings.title: Title separator encoding issue on 8 pages
findings.description: 8 pages use raw unicode em dash (\u2014) in <title> instead of —. Can cause garbled display in SERPs on some crawlers.
findings.recommendation: Replace raw \u2014 with — in all affected page titles.

findings.title: Footer uses semantic H4 for navigation
findings.description: Footer headings 'Tools', 'Info', 'GIF Compressor' use <h4>, creating broken heading hierarchy on every page.
findings.recommendation: Change footer headings from <h4> to <span> with the same CSS styling.

findings.title: Resize GIF page drops from H1 to H2 without content
findings.description: The only H2 after the dropzone is 'More tools' — a utility nav section. Makes the page look content-thin to crawlers.
findings.recommendation: Add substantive H2 sections (How to Resize, Use Cases, Best Practices).

findings.title: No visible breadcrumb navigation
findings.description: Breadcrumbs only exist in JSON-LD, not in the visible UI. Visible breadcrumbs improve UX and internal linking.
findings.recommendation: Add visible breadcrumbs in Base.astro layout or on a per-page basis.

findings.title: Double-encoded ampersand in blog card title
findings.description: Blog index shows &amp; instead of & on the Discord/Twitter blog card due to template rendering issue.
findings.recommendation: Fix template rendering to avoid double HTML entity encoding.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: BreadcrumbList schema on every page via Base.astro
FAQPage schema on 5 tool pages
All schema is valid JSON-LD

findings.title: No structured data on homepage
findings.description: Homepage lacks WebApplication and Organization schema. This is the single most important page for structured data.
findings.recommendation: Add WebApplication (free tool) + Organization (brand entity) JSON-LD to index.astro.

findings.title: WebApplication schema missing on tool pages
findings.description: 8 tool pages lack WebApplication schema, blocking Google tool-rich-result opportunities.
findings.recommendation: Add WebApplication JSON-LD specific to each tool on each tool page.

findings.title: Blog posts lack Article/BlogPosting schema
findings.description: No BlogPosting structured data on any of the 5 blog posts. Blocks article carousel eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Add BlogPosting schema in blog layout template with datePublished, headline, and author.

findings.title: HowTo schema opportunity on compress-gif page
findings.description: The 'How to Compress a GIF' section is a perfect HowTo rich result candidate but lacks HowTo + HowToStep schema.
findings.recommendation: Add HowTo JSON-LD with numbered HowToStep items.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Total dist size is only 350 KB — exceptionally lightweight
No large framework — vanilla JS tools (45 KB total)
Google Fonts preconnect hints present
Service worker for repeat-visit caching

findings.title: Monolithic CSS blocks first paint
findings.description: 29 KB CSS file is render-blocking. On slow 3G this is ~0.5s. Most tool pages use only ~40% of rules.
findings.recommendation: Extract critical CSS per page or use CSS code splitting.

findings.title: Google Fonts blocks text rendering
findings.description: External font CSS blocks text rendering despite preconnect. No display=swap parameter.
findings.recommendation: Self-host the Geist font or add display=swap to the Google Fonts URL.

findings.title: JS files load on every page
findings.description: batch-compressor.js (13 KB) and gif-to-mp4.js (5 KB) load on all pages, not just their respective tool pages.
findings.recommendation: Use dynamic imports or per-page script loading.

findings.title: Empty img src causes wasted network requests
findings.description: 8 empty src='' tags cause browsers to retry the current page URL as an image request.
findings.recommendation: Use a 1x1 transparent data URI or CSS background instead.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Alt text present on all image tags

findings.title: OG image /og-default.png does not exist
findings.description: All 17 pages reference /og-default.png in og:image and twitter:image. Social sharing produces zero-image link cards.
findings.recommendation: Create a 1200x630 PNG and place at public/og-default.png.

findings.title: Empty img src on placeholder images
findings.description: 8 empty src='' tags across tool pages with alt text like 'Original GIF' and 'Result'. src='' causes wasted requests.
findings.recommendation: Use transparent 1x1 placeholder data URI.

findings.title: Favicon is SVG-only, no PNG fallback
findings.description: Older browsers and services (Slack unfurl, Apple touch icon) require PNG favicons.
findings.recommendation: Add PNG favicon and Apple touch icon to public/.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: High-quality technical blog content is inherently citable
Privacy angle (browser-based processing) is a strong differentiator signal

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: AI crawlers have no structured content manifest. llms.txt significantly improves AI citation rates for tool sites.
findings.recommendation: Create public/llms.txt with tool listing and blog post URLs.

findings.title: No WebApplication schema for AI tool categorization
findings.description: Without structured data declaring the site as a free tool, AI search engines cannot properly categorize and cite it.
findings.recommendation: Add WebApplication schema on homepage and tool pages.

findings.title: Blog posts lack Article schema for citation readiness
findings.description: Technical blog content is highly citable but lacks structured citation data (datePublished, author, headline).
findings.recommendation: Add BlogPosting schema to all blog posts.
